chars.RACHIDA: RACHIDA: a Moroccan woman in her late 20s with black hair in a low bun, wearing a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a plain white top, a long dark green skirt and small gold hoop earrings.
chars.LADY: LADY: a wealthy elderly Italian woman with short silver hair, a pearl necklace, an elegant navy-blue blazer and cream trousers.
chars.KAMAL: KAMAL: a tired Moroccan man in his 30s with a short black beard, wearing a grey hoodie with paint stains and dark blue work trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In the bright marble entrance hall of a luxurious Italian villa, LADY smiles warmly and places a ring of house keys into RACHIDA's open hand; RACHIDA looks grateful and surprised.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: RACHIDA alone in a huge elegant Italian living room with chandeliers and paintings, holding a duster, slowly looking around at all the expensive things, the house silent.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: RACHIDA honest and humble, sitting on a simple bed in a tiny modest room, gently folding a small child's clothes, calm kind expression.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: RACHIDA at a small cramped kitchen table at night under a weak lamp, a pile of unpaid bills in front of her, head in her hands, exhausted and worried.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: RACHIDA standing in front of a bathroom mirror in a small apartment, staring at her own reflection with a conflicted, troubled expression.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a luxurious bedroom of the Italian villa, RACHIDA pauses while cleaning and stares sideways with a long suspicious look at a large closed wardrobe, tense mood.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a small poor apartment, KAMAL sits exhausted on an old sofa after work while RACHIDA stands with crossed arms looking at him coldly with resentment.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At night RACHIDA stands by a dark window in a small apartment, city lights outside, her face half lit, eyes narrowed, deep in calculating thought.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Dramatic close-up of RACHIDA in a dim room lit by red evening light, a slow sly dangerous smile spreading on her face as a dark idea forms, suspenseful thriller mood.
